## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and they spend an enjoyable evening sharing stories, tea, and candy. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) opens up about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to suggest bringing his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), for a visit. A month later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) introduces [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two quickly form a warm and fond connection.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a busy month helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her upcoming wedding and discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) stumbles upon [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) professing their love for each other in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. The next evening, [Diana](../character/diana.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reflect on love and her own imagined future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) visit [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to help [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden in front of their guests, after which everyone sees them off at the station. While locking up the stone house afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, poignant moment that subtly alters the nature of their relationship as they look toward their college years.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

> After finishing term examinations at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday where she is warmly greeted by [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and the twins. That night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps a troubled [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a dilemma about wanting to say a bad word so that he feels ready to say his prayers. During the break, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives letters from her friends, shares news with her family, and visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana.md) to air out the house and listen to the echoes once more.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends her summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) enjoying visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and the Irvings, though she is secretly bothered by Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) deals with growing up and losing his imaginative childhood visions at the shore. Later at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) gently questions [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her disrupted relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People
